mapping.meaning: One payment from one account to another. The data is synthetic.
When the payment was made, to the minute.
The account the money arrives in.
A natural logarithm, not the amount: ln(1 + amount paid). An amount of 1000 is stored as about 6.9.
True when the payment currency differs from the receiving currency.
True when the paying and the receiving account are the same account.
True when both accounts are at the same bank.

mapping.from: fmt_wire, fmt_ach, fmt_cheque, fmt_cash, fmt_credit_card, fmt_bitcoin, fmt_reinvestment
mapping.meaning: How the payment was made, for example wire, cash or cheque. One of seven formats: wire, ach, cheque, cash, credit card, bitcoin, reinvestment. Four of them match AML typology value instruments (see also): cash, cheque, credit card and bitcoin. Wire, ach and reinvestment have no direct counterpart.

mapping.how: its own TriplesMap, a UNION of both columns
mapping.meaning: An account that sends or receives payments. Only its identifier is known: there is no table of accounts, customers or companies.

checks.text: Every class and property the mapping uses is defined in the ontology.
Every column the mapping reads exists in the table.
Every one of the 15 columns of the table is used by the mapping.
Each property belongs to the class of the records it is attached to (domain).
Each object has the datatype, or points to the class, that the ontology gives as the range.
Every AML typology entry the ontology points to exists in AML typology.
